caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a bottle with a stopper. The bottle has a wide, rounded base that tapers into a tall, narrow neck and ends with a flared rim. The surface of the bottle is decorated with vertical, slightly wavy stripes alternating in shades of pale green and light gray, giving it a translucent, glass-like appearance. The stopper is conical, white or light gray, and fits snugly into the neck of the bottle. The background is plain and beige, with a slightly darker border near the edges, and the bottle is positioned in the center of the composition. There is a small, simple scale drawn in pencil at the lower left and a handwritten signature reading "Gertrude Lambert" at the lower right.
title: Barber Shop Bottle
